title: Cyclic projection of the specified completed diagonal class
statement: Let l be prime, Y,P=ProjectiveLine Y,W=diagonalSurface Y Noetherian, l invertible on Y, and supply the three DiagonalTraceLocalizations. Let D be a derived simultaneous reduction with DiagonalCompletionSpec and DiagonalCycleSystemSpec, and let delta be a completed arrow satisfying IsDiagonalLimit. Let family be a coefficient Family and reference a Reference to this same whole delta [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. For every n there exists a CyclicCartierFrame p [def-diagonal-cyclic-cartier-frame] whose reduction of family.zl.delta equals geoCartierCanonicalClass over R=ULift(Z/l^(n+1)), with the positive Cartier sign. No finite extension E, uniformizer, quotient coefficient algebra or trace conclusion occurs.

proof.text: Construct the frame independently of the completed arrow. Use the finite-discrete realization and direct-image comparison helpers, the regular flat scalar endpoint, supported flatness and the ordinary supported scalar unit, and flatness of zlLine. Construct the integral and finite root maps, then apply the cyclic root endpoint lemma. Package these data in CyclicCartierFrame.

Apply the finite coefficient transport comparison to the supplied frame and IsDiagonalLimit. It identifies the integral restrictions of its cyclic reduction and cartierResidueReducedPro. The proved cyclic restriction-detection theorem cancels this restriction.

Use the uniqueness clause of cartier_reduction_site_comparison on geoCartierCanonicalClass. Its etale boundary witness is geoCartierEtaleClass, with geoCartierEtaleClass_spec and geoCartierCanonicalClass_comparison. This identifies cartierResidueReducedPro with the canonical positive class. Substitute into the result of the preceding step.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalCompleted_cyclicCartier
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (hcompletion : DiagonalCompletionSpec l (diagonalSurface Y) D)
    (hsystem : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec l Y hY D)
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (hδ : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (family : Family l Y) (reference : Reference l Y δ family) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ p : CyclicCartierFrame l Y n,
      p.reduce l Y n family.zl.delta =
        geoCartierCanonicalClass (diagonalResidue.{u} l n) (l ^ (n + 1))
          (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) (cartierResidue_cast l (n + 1))
          (diagonalImmersion Y) (diagonalImmersion_cartier Y)
          (diagonalSurface_power_unit l Y hY n)
